    • Method Detail

      • adaptExportLogic

        @KeepSecretFromPublishedApi
void adaptExportLogic(groovy.lang.Closure<?> exportAdapter)
        This method can be used to change the used export filter, with the Closure code. This will change the behavior of this IPersistencyModelExportApi.IModelExporter instance.

        Note: This is an advanced feature to change the export filter. This is not part of the PublishedApi!

        Arguments: The first argument is the existing export filter. The second argument is the IPersistencyExportFilterFactory. The third argument converts a Closure to an export filter.

        Parameters:
        exportAdapter - the code to adapt the filter
